name: H-ATLAS J091305.0-005343 (Hubble)
blurb: H-ATLAS J091305.0-005343, a gravitationally lensed dusty galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: sdss091305005343-hubble
story: Here a spiral galaxy in the foreground bends the light of a dust-shrouded galaxy far behind it, one of the first gravitational lenses found by the Herschel ATLAS survey. The hidden galaxy is caught in a fierce burst of star formation, and Hubble's sharp view helps astronomers reconstruct its true shape.
